summary: SOFT road features to avoid where possible (ferry avoided by default).
range: Array enum: toll | highway | bbox | left_turn | right_turn | sharp_turn | uturn | service_road | ferry | none. Case-sensitive. bbox is a hard geo filter.
constraints: Values from the enum set; case-sensitive.
businessRules: Soft preference EXCEPT bbox, which hard-filters to a bounding box (min_lat,min_lon,max_lat,max_lon).

avoid defines: Specify the type of objects/maneuvers that the route should avoid. This is a soft-constraint. The optimizer would try to avoid the given objects/maneuvers as long as there are feasible, alternative…
Each element in avoid must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Valid options: toll, highway, bbox, left_turn, right_turn, .... Each affects solver behavior differently.
Routing attributes affect which roads/zones are accessible; conflicts cause unsolvable requests.
Must stay consistent with: options.routing.exclude. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: test with avoid set to "toll"
Positive: test with avoid set to "highway"
Positive: test with avoid set to "bbox"
Positive: test with avoid set to "left_turn"
Positive: test with avoid set to "right_turn"
Positive: test with avoid set to "sharp_turn"
Positive: test with avoid set to "uturn"
Positive: test with avoid set to "service_road"
Positive: test with avoid set to "ferry"
Positive: test with avoid set to "none"
